name: Yates Center RV Park
note: City of Yates Center RV park beside the Woodson County fairgrounds at the NW corner of US-75 and 105th Rd (the council minutes call it the Armory Campground): a row of angled gravel pull-through lanes on open grass. The city's other RV park is South Owl Lake, 0.5 km SW down 105th Rd. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: City of Yates Center lakes page, read 2026-11-06: 'THE CITY OF YATES CENTER HAS TWO RV PARKS. YATES CENTER RV PARK IS LOCATED ON HWY 75 & 105TH ROAD ... BOTH HAVE ELECTRIC AND WATER HOOKUPS ... DUMP STATION ONLY AT YATES CENTER RV PARK. $20.00 PER NIGHT ($25.00 FOR FIRST NIGHT IF RESERVED)'; city council minutes 2024-11-18 ('upgrade the Armory Campground ... sewer hookups for the 10 sites plus add 50 amp electric') and 2025-08-04 / 2025-12-01 / 2025-12-15 (council granting campers extended stays) show it operating; Google satellite (2026 tiles) shows ~6 angled gravel pull-through lanes ~50 m long at 37.8722,-95.7398 with a trailer rig parked in one -> real local drive-in RV campground (public, no price gate; ladder rung 1: the town's own page names it). Not South Owl 2188 (0.55 km SW at the lake, own access down 105th Rd, sewer there and not here) and not Still Waters Edge 2236 (private, 4.5 km NW).
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-06: Google satellite tiles (z18/z20, rendered) and Esri World Imagery (2.2 km and 520 m frames, rendered) at 37.8722,-95.7398: the pull-through lanes sit on open grass between the fairground buildings and 105th Rd, with no water on or beside the site. Nearest water: a farm pond under an acre across US-75 to the SE, a small pond ~200 m S beyond 105th Rd and a nursing-home lot, and South Owl Lake ~0.5 km SW behind roads and woods. Not waterfront.

fees.note: City of Yates Center: $20 a night, $25 for the first night if reserved.

fees_source: https://cityofyatescenter.com/lakes/ ('$20.00 PER NIGHT ($25.00 FOR FIRST NIGHT IF RESERVED). FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION CONTACT CITY HALL 620-625-2118', one rate for both city RV parks; page undated), read 2026-11-06. Same fee shape as sibling 2188.

booking.note: Reserve through Yates Center City Hall; after hours, campers call the Sheriff's Department.

booking_source: https://cityofyatescenter.com/lakes/ ('$25.00 FOR FIRST NIGHT IF RESERVED ... CONTACT CITY HALL 620-625-2118'), read 2026-11-06; council minutes 2024-10-21 (https://cityofyatescenter.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/October-21-2024.pdf, 'campers need to call City Hall if during business hours or the Sheriffs Department after hours, weekends or holidays')
rvlife: not listed (RV Life Algolia, box 37.83-37.92 / -95.80 to -95.68, 2026-11-06: only South Owl RV Park and Still Waters Edge Retreat)
flags: hookups: electric yes (amperage not stated, so omitted; the 2024-11-18 minutes propose to 'add 50 amp electric to each site', so it is under 50 today), water yes, sewer no -- https://cityofyatescenter.com/lakes/ ('BOTH HAVE ELECTRIC AND WATER HOOKUPS. SEWER HOOKUP AVAILABLE AT SOUTH OWL LAKE RV PARK ONLY'), read 2026-11-06; minutes 2024-11-18 ('We would need to have sewer hookups for the 10 sites')
facilities.dump true -- same lakes page ('DUMP STATION ONLY AT YATES CENTER RV PARK'); 2188 already carries dump:false and points here

sites.count 10 -- city council minutes 2024-11-18 (https://cityofyatescenter.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/November-18-2024.pdf): 'upgrade the Armory Campground ... sewer hookups for the 10 sites'. Identification of 'Armory Campground' with this park is an inference: the city has two RV parks, the minutes treat the Armory one as lacking sewer, and only the US-75 park lacks sewer; a 2025-12-01 entry has a camper 'staying at the armory location'

sites.pull_through true -- Google satellite tiles (2026) show ~6 angled drive-through gravel lanes ~50 m long; Esri World Imagery is older and shows only the grass oval with its loop track, before the lanes were built
max rig: none published; lanes ~50 m long, so a 23-ft rig fits easily

booking: reservable by phone at City Hall; walk-ups evidently happen (2024-10-07 minutes: campers 'pull in, possibly occupying a reserved spot and not paying'; the council planned utility locks and a call-in sign)

stay length: no posted limit found; the council grants case-by-case extended stays (to 2025-09-10, 2026-01-01, 2026-02-01) to people repairing homes or recovering from surgery, which implies some limit. Not a residential park: nightly rate posted, no application

distance check: 0.55 km straight-line from 2188 South Owl Lake (37.8685,-95.74388) -- under the ~1 km split guide, but this is not a sub-campground of one park: the city lists them as two separately named RV parks with different hookups (sewer vs dump), one at the fairgrounds on US-75 and the other at the lake ~1/2 mile down 105th Rd. AWH may want to confirm it should stand as its own entry
Google Maps has no listing for this park (searches 2026-11-06 return South Owl Lake Campground and Still Waters Edge only); the 4-H Community Building next door is 711 S Fry St
phone is Yates Center City Hall (same as 2188)
